lead.titleZh: 重构患者期望：肌骨康复关键治疗靶点
lead.titleEn: Reframing Patient Expectations: Key Therapeutic Targets in MSK Rehab
lead.paragraphZh: 今天共 4 条更新，涵盖 3 个专业领域。其中 2 条得分 75，一篇述评和一项观察研究，探讨了肌肉骨骼康复中患者期望的重构和卒中后平衡信心的领域特定特征。另有一项观察研究，提示意大利物理治疗师在临床感觉测试认知上的挑战。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's update includes 4 items across 3 specialties. Two studies scored 75: a review article on reframing patient expectations in musculoskeletal rehabilitation and an observational study characterizing domain-specific balance confidence post-stroke. Another observational study highlights challenges in Italian physical therapists' awareness of clinical sensory testing.

items.title: Reframing patient expectations as therapeutic targets in musculoskeletal care.
items.summary: This professional practice article argues that patient expectations (PEs) are not merely prognostic indicators but modifiable, multidimensional therapeutic targets that extend beyond treatment and recovery to influence outcomes in musculoskeletal care.
items.curatedReason: 这篇专业实践文章提醒你，患者期望不只是预后因素，更是可主动干预的治疗靶点。在骨科 / 肌肉骨骼康复中，你需要更重视其对治疗效果的影响。
items.titleZh: 重构患者期望为肌肉骨骼康复中的治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 这篇专业实践文章指出，患者期望（PEs）不仅是预后指标，更是可被调整、多维度的治疗靶点，其影响超越治疗和康复本身，在肌肉骨骼护理中能塑性治疗效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This professional practice article reminds you that patient expectations are not just prognostic factors but modifiable therapeutic targets. In orthopedic/musculoskeletal rehabilitation, you need to pay more attention to their impact on treatment outcomes.

items.title: Clinical sensory tests in professional practice: a web-based survey on awareness and challenges among Italian physicians and physiotherapists.
items.summary: A cross-sectional web-based survey among Italian physicians and physiotherapists identified self-reported perceptions, preferred approaches, and perceived barriers to clinical sensory testing in practice.
items.curatedReason: 这项意大利调查揭示了物理治疗师对临床感觉测试的认知和实践障碍。对美国、中国、澳大利亚的临床实践借鉴意义有限，但可作为同类实践调研的参考。
items.titleZh: 意大利医师和物理治疗师对临床感觉测试的认知与挑战：一项网络调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对意大利执业医师和物理治疗师的横断面网络调查，旨在描述他们对临床感觉测试的自我感知、偏好方法以及感知到的障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Italian survey identifies physiotherapists' perceptions and practice barriers regarding clinical sensory testing. While its direct relevance to clinical practice in the US, China, or Australia is limited, it can serve as a reference for similar practice surveys.
items.limitation: 本研究为意大利执业医师和物理治疗师的自填式网络问卷调查，可能存在选择偏倚和回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a self-reported web-based survey among Italian physicians and physiotherapists, which may be subject to selection and recall bias.

items.title: A domain-specific approach to characterizing balance confidence post-stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis confirmed that the Activities-Specific Balance Confidence (ABC) scale consists of three factors—anticipatory control, walking balance, and reactive balance—in 248 community-dwelling adults with chronic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究证实了卒中后平衡信心（ABC 量表）在三个特定领域存在结构。下次评估卒中患者的平衡信心时，可以多关注这三个维度：预期控制、步行平衡和反应性平衡。
items.titleZh: 卒中后平衡信心的领域特定特征：一项研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面分析对 248 名慢性卒中患者的现有数据进行研究，证实了“活动特异性平衡信心量表”（ABC 量表）包含预期控制、步行平衡和反应性平衡三个因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study confirmed the structural integrity of balance confidence (ABC scale) post-stroke across three specific domains. When assessing balance confidence in stroke patients, consider these three dimensions: anticipatory control, walking balance, and reactive balance.
items.limitation: 本研究是对现有数据的横断面分析，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional analysis of existing data, which precludes causal inference and may be subject to reporting bias.

items.title: Operational AI Adoption in U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities: Organizational Selection and Domain Heterogeneity, 2021-2024
items.summary: U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRFs) are increasingly adopting operational AI solutions between 2021 and 2024, driven by workforce shortages and the complex Medicare prospective payment system, with varied adoption across clinical domains.
items.curatedReason: 这份报告显示美国住院康复机构（IRF）正在加速采用 AI，特别是在劳动力短缺和 Medicare 复杂报销压力下。它提示你，AI 在IRF 的应用正从早期尝试转向运营实践，你所在机构的未来运营模式可能会因此改变。
items.titleZh: 美国住院康复机构的运营级 AI 采用：组织选择与领域异质性，2021-2024
items.summaryZh: 受劳动力短缺和复杂 Medicare 预付款制度驱动，美国住院康复机构（IRFs）在2021至2024年间加速采用运营级 AI 解决方案，不同临床领域的采用情况存在异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This report shows that U.S. Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRFs) are accelerating AI adoption, particularly under workforce shortages and complex Medicare reimbursement pressures. It suggests that AI applications in IRFs are shifting from early trials to operational practice, potentially altering future operating models for your facility.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
